related.title: 阿維多爾多燃料熱電聯產電廠
related.titleEn: Avedøre Multi-Fuel Combined Heat and Power Plant
related.transfer: 可遷移「抽汽供熱所犧牲的電力」與「回水溫度與輸送能力」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；阿維多爾多燃料熱電聯產電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Power given up to extract heat" and "Return temperature and carrying capacity" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Avedøre Multi-Fuel Combined Heat and Power Plant must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦同時賣電又賣熱的城市能源系統：抽汽的代價、一次能源節省、蓄熱、回水溫度、管網熱損、熱泵與煙氣冷凝；阿維多爾多燃料熱電聯產電廠則以由燃煤轉為生質能的熱電廠：超超臨界參數、木質顆粒與麥稈的用量、蓄熱槽與供應鏈排放為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A city energy system selling power and heat together: cost of extraction, primary energy saving, heat storage, return temperature, network loss, heat pumps and flue-gas condensation; Avedøre Multi-Fuel Combined Heat and Power Plant centres on A heat and power plant converted from coal to biomass: ultra-supercritical steam, pellet and straw consumption, heat storage and supply-chain emissions, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「汽電共生的總效率」與「汽電共生的總效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」的模型移到阿維多爾多燃料熱電聯產電廠，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「蓄熱槽可支撐的時數」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Total efficiency of cogeneration" and "Total efficiency of cogeneration".
Move the model of "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling" to Avedøre Multi-Fuel Combined Heat and Power Plant, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Hours the heat stores can carry", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「抽汽供熱所犧牲的電力」與「回水溫度與輸送能力」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；阿維多爾多燃料熱電聯產電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Power given up to extract heat" and "Return temperature and carrying capacity" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Avedøre Multi-Fuel Combined Heat and Power Plant must be respecified.

related.title: 有機朗肯循環餘熱發電
related.titleEn: Organic Rankine Cycle Waste Heat Recovery
related.transfer: 可遷移「抽汽供熱所犧牲的電力」與「回水溫度與輸送能力」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；有機朗肯循環餘熱發電的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Power given up to extract heat" and "Return temperature and carrying capacity" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Organic Rankine Cycle Waste Heat Recovery must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦同時賣電又賣熱的城市能源系統：抽汽的代價、一次能源節省、蓄熱、回水溫度、管網熱損、熱泵與煙氣冷凝；有機朗肯循環餘熱發電則以把丟掉的熱變成電：餘熱量、第二定律效率、最佳蒸發溫度、回熱、氣溫影響與回收年限為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A city energy system selling power and heat together: cost of extraction, primary energy saving, heat storage, return temperature, network loss, heat pumps and flue-gas condensation; Organic Rankine Cycle Waste Heat Recovery centres on turning discarded heat into power: waste heat available, second-law efficiency, best evaporating temperature, recuperation, air temperature and payback, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「汽電共生的總效率」與「可回收的餘熱與發電量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」的模型移到有機朗肯循環餘熱發電，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「冷卻氣溫的影響」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Total efficiency of cogeneration" and "Recoverable waste heat and power".
Move the model of "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling" to Organic Rankine Cycle Waste Heat Recovery, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Effect of cooling air temperature", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「抽汽供熱所犧牲的電力」與「回水溫度與輸送能力」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；有機朗肯循環餘熱發電的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Power given up to extract heat" and "Return temperature and carrying capacity" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Organic Rankine Cycle Waste Heat Recovery must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 區域能源熱電聯供系統
history.titleEn: District Energy Combined Heat and Power Systems
history.text: 1903 年哥本哈根建成第一座垃圾焚化熱電廠；1979 年丹麥通過供熱法並推動區域供熱規劃；2017 年新一代垃圾焚化廠啟用。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1903: Copenhagen built its first waste-fired heat and power plant. 1979: Denmark passed its heat supply act and began district heating planning. 2017: A new-generation waste-to-energy plant opened. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
